_readme: Address tags. type is one of: exchange, pool, burn, project, other. Types exchange, pool and burn are hidden in the 'without exchanges and pools' view. Optional conf: likely (from a community source or on-chain pattern, still counted as exchange/pool) or unverified (shown only; use type other so it is not excluded). Optional src: where the tag comes from. Add a line, commit, and the next daily run picks it up (history is re-tagged too).
